item.title: American Pinball Hot Wheels Classic Pinball Machine at No Reserve
item.description: This Hot Wheels Classic pinball machine was manufactured by American Pinball of Palatine, Illinois and was recently purchased and upgraded by the seller. The machine features a shaker motor, illuminated flipper buttons, flippers, bumpers, drop targets, a vertical upkick loop, and a glass playfield cover. item.title: 65-Mile 2023 Mercedes-AMG G63 4×4²
item.description: This 2023 Mercedes-AMG G63 4x4² was first delivered in British Columbia, Canada, where it was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025 and imported to the US. Finished in Manufaktur Cardinal Red Magno over Black G Manufaktur Nappa leather, the truck is powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V8 linked with a nine-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.title: 43k-Mile 2016 BMW Z4 sDrive28i
item.description: This 2016 BMW Z4 sDrive28i roadster has 43k miles, and it has spent most of its time registered in Florida. The car remained in the original owner's care until February 2023, and it was purchased by the seller about a month later. It is finished in Melbourne Red Metallic over Canberra Beige Kansas leather and is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four paired with an eight-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. item.title: 3.0L-Powered 1976 Porsche 912E Safari-Style Coupe
item.description: This 1976 Porsche 912E coupe was acquired by the seller as an ex-NASA/SCCA rallycross race car in 2023, and it was subsequently rebuilt as a Safari-style coupe. The 3.0-liter flat-six and 915 five-speed manual were rebuilt, the lifted suspension was overhauled with Elephant Racing products, and the body repaired and wrapped in camo-themed vinyl. It is finished in Jet Black over Obsidian Black leather and is equipped with 19" 10-spoke alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, heated power-adjustable front seats, a navigation system, a Linn sound system, cruise control, and automatic climate control. item.title: 1981 Porsche 911SC Targa
item.description: This 1981 Porsche 911SC is a Mocha Black-finished Targa that remained registered in California until the seller's purchase in 2024, and its 3.0-liter flat-six was rebuilt to European specifications that same year. Shifting is through a five-speed manual transaxle, and the interior houses Recaro bucket seats trimmed in black cloth. item.title: 1970 Oldsmobile 442 Convertible
item.description: This 1970 Oldsmobile 442 convertible underwent a cosmetic and mechanical refurbishment just after the seller's acquisition in 2007. The blue convertible body is complemented with a white convertible top and stripes, and the cabin is outfitted with Ivory vinyl upholstery, faux woodgrain trim, a Custom Sport steering wheel, air conditioning, an AM/FM radio, and power windows. item.title: 1k-Mile 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Roadster
item.description: This 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Roadster is a Canadian-market car that was registered in Ontario and Quebec before being imported to the US in 2025. item.title: 1969 Lamborghini Miura P400 S
item.description: This 1969 Lamborghini Miura P400 S is one of approximately 750 Miuras built between 1966 and 1973 and is among 338 examples of the S variant built during the middle two years of that span. Chassis 3919 was completed on January 29, 1969, and was delivered new via Lamborauto in Turin, Italy. The car underwent a three-year refurbishment by Bobileff Motorcar Company in San Diego, California, that was completed in 2008 and subsequently won awards at the Italiano Concorso and the Palos Verdes Concours
